title: Separate lifecycles, one Saga
statement: As a change author, I can keep living product requirements and implementation review decks under one Saga identity without conflating their lifecycles.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A v3 Report Saga can contain zero or more focused decks whose targets derive from the parent Saga identity.
Each deck bundle, requirement record, relation, and review event remains an independently mergeable record.
Existing v2 and v3 reports and standalone v4 slide Sagas retain their established reading behavior.
